cohort: 1286 primiparous women who had a caesarean delivery and 2099 primiparous women who had a vaginal delivery
finding: Vaginal delivery, especially forceps delivery, may result in impaired pelvic floor muscle function in the early postpartum period compared to cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery, especially forceps delivery, may result in impaired pelvic floor muscle function in the early postpartum period compared to cesarean delivery.
